basic_details.short_information: The walk-in written test-cum-interview for Project Fellow positions will be held on 16 November 2026 at 9.00 AM at ICAR-Sugarcane Breeding Institute, Coimbatore-7 (Tamilnadu). ICAR-Sugarcane Breeding Institute (ICAR-SBI) proposes to fill these positions on a contractual basis, as and when required within a period of one year, under the ICAR-EFC Genome editing projects. The emoluments are Rs.20,000/- per month (consolidated), and the positions are open to Male, Female and Transgender candidates.

important_instructions: The position is purely on a temporary basis and is co-terminus with the project. There is no provision of re-employment after termination of the project; selected candidates will have no right to claim a pay scale or absorption against any regular post at the Institute. The selected candidate will work on a whole time basis and will not be allowed to register for any academic programme. Selected candidates must produce all original documents (certificates) and a medical certificate at the time of joining. Concealing of facts or canvassing in any form shall lead to cancellation of candidature or termination. Any dispute will be resolved in the jurisdiction of Coimbatore court only.

content_sections.heading: About ICAR-SBI Project Fellow
content_sections.text: ICAR-Sugarcane Breeding Institute, Coimbatore – 641007, describes itself on its letterhead as an ISO 9001:2008 certified Institute of ICAR. The Project Fellow positions are under the ICAR-EFC Genome editing projects on "Enhancing climate resilience and ensuring food security with genome editing tool". The notification is issued by Dinesh Nagpal, Chief Administrative Officer.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The only position advertised is Project Fellow . The appointment runs from the date of joining to 31.03.2027 or until the projects end (co-terminus), whichever is earlier. The emoluments are Rs.20,000/- per month (consolidated). Three or Four years Bachelor degree in B.Sc / B.Tech from a recognized university in any of the following: Agriculture biotechnology Plant Breeding and Genetics Biotechnology Life Sciences Basic Sciences Biochemistry Bioinformatics Botany (Botany with specialization in molecular biology and bioinformatics) The candidate should hold the Degree certificate (at least a Provisional certificate) in original. Candidates with website results or awaiting results will not be allowed or considered. Working experience in sugarcane Master Graduation in any degree in life/basic sciences The upper age limits are 30 years for men and 35 years for women. The bio-data proforma asks for age as on 16.11.2026. The age limits are relaxable for SC, ST and OBC candidates as per Govt. of India norms; candidates claiming age relaxation must enclose the appropriate community certificate. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the Project Fellow position.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The notice asks candidates to bring the following at the time of the written test for verification: Bio-data in the prescribed proforma (printed with the notice; it asks for name, gender, father's name, date of birth, age as on 16.11.2026, community, education from SSLC, HSC and B.Sc/B.Tech, work experience, other technical qualifications, address, e-mail ID and mobile/WhatsApp number, with a passport size photograph affixed) All original certificates from SSLC onwards One set of self-attested photocopies of certificates Experience certificate Latest passport size photograph Community certificate, if age relaxation is claimed No objection certificate from the employer, if employed elsewhere Candidates who fail to submit original certificates for verification will not be allowed for the written test.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Selection is through a written test cum interview, conducted in person at ICAR-SBI, Coimbatore on 16.11.2026 at 9.00 AM. All eligible candidates are requested to be present 60 minutes before reporting time for necessary formalities and verification of documents. No TA/DA will be paid to any candidate to attend the written test. The Director, ICAR-SBI, Cbe-7 reserves the right to cancel or postpone the scheduled written test cum interview without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The position is purely on a temporary basis and is co-terminus with the project. There is no provision of re-employment after termination of the project; selected candidates will have no right to claim a pay scale or absorption against any regular post at the Institute. The selected candidate will work on a whole time basis and will not be allowed to register for any academic programme. Selected candidates must produce all original documents (certificates) and a medical certificate at the time of joining. Concealing of facts or canvassing in any form shall lead to cancellation of candidature or termination. The decision of the Director, ICAR-SBI, Coimbatore will be final and binding; the Director may terminate the contract even before completion of the project/contract period, with no appeal. Any dispute will be resolved in the jurisdiction of Coimbatore court only.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ICAR-SBI Project Fellow walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The written test cum interview is on 16 November 2026 at 9.00 AM at ICAR-Sugarcane Breeding Institute, Coimbatore-7 (Tamilnadu).

faq.question: Q2. How early should candidates arrive?
faq.answer: Candidates are requested to be present 60 minutes before reporting time for formalities and verification of documents.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for ICAR-SBI Project Fellow?
faq.answer: A three or four years Bachelor degree in B.Sc / B.Tech in Agriculture biotechnology, Plant Breeding and Genetics, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Basic Sciences, Biochemistry, Bioinformatics or Botany (with specialization in molecular biology and bioinformatics) from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ICAR-SBI Project Fellow?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years for men and 35 years for women, relaxable for SC, ST and OBC candidates as per Govt. of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an ICAR-SBI Project Fellow?
faq.answer: The emoluments are Rs.20,000/- per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. What documents should be brought to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Bio-data in the prescribed proforma, all original certificates from SSLC onwards, one set of self-attested photocopies, experience certificate and a latest passport size photograph.

faq.question: Q7. How will ICAR-SBI select Project Fellows?
faq.answer: Selection is through a written test cum interview conducted in person at ICAR-SBI, Coimbatore on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the ICAR-SBI Project Fellow appointment?
faq.answer: From the date of joining to 31 March 2027 or co-terminus with the projects, whichever is earlier; the position is purely temporary.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates awaiting results attend?
faq.answer: No. Candidates must hold the Degree certificate (at least a Provisional certificate) in original; website results or awaiting-result candidates will not be allowed or considered.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the written test?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid to any candidate to attend the written test.
